families.title: A.1
families.description: Identity family for untwisted affine type A.

families.title: A.3
families.description: Parametric cyclic family including the affine-node position t.

branches.label: General case
branches.description: Both index intervals are nonempty and the paired block does not reach its maximal endpoint.

branches.label: Empty left block
branches.description: The first diagonal interval disappears; the master formula is read with the corresponding sum empty.

branches.label: Maximal paired block
branches.description: The paired block reaches the midpoint of the t-interval.

branches.label: Boundary intersection
branches.description: Both degenerations occur simultaneously: the left interval is empty and the paired block is maximal.

families.title: A.2
families.description: Constant symplectic block family in even dimension.

families.title: A.4
families.description: Half-period exchange family in even dimension.

families.title: B.1
families.description: Untwisted odd-orthogonal exchange family of the BD.1 master class.

families.title: B.2
families.description: Untwisted odd-orthogonal alternating family of the BD.2 master class.

families.title: C.1
families.description: Identity-involution family parametrised by the distinguished nodes ell and r.

definitions.label: Matrix terms
definitions.latex: \widetilde M_1(u),\ \widetilde M_2(u),\ \widetilde M_3(u)\text{ are the explicit matrix-unit sums in Result \mathrm{C.1}_{\mathrm{nstd}}}

families.title: C.2

families.title: C.4

families.title: D.1
families.description: Untwisted even-orthogonal exchange family of the BD.1 master class.

definitions.label: Family terms
definitions.latex: M_1(u)\text{ is the BCD.12 diagonal term and }M_2(u)=\sum_{\bar r\leq i<\bar\ell}(\lambda E_{-i,-i}+\lambda^{-1}E_{ii}+E_{-i,i}+E_{i,-i})

families.title: D.2
families.description: Untwisted even-orthogonal alternating family with endpoint corrections.

constraints.latex: \mu\text{ is free for }\ell\in\{0,1\};\quad\lambda\text{ is free for }r\in\{n-1,n\}

definitions.label: Parameters
definitions.latex: N=2n,\quad\lambda=q^{n-r-1},\quad\mu=q^{-\ell+1};\quad\lambda\text{ is free for }r\in\{n-1,n\},\qquad\mu\text{ is free for }\ell\in\{0,1\}

families.title: D.3
families.description: Exceptional D4 triality family: the only vector boundary intertwiner is zero.

generalFormula.latex: K(u)=0\quad\text{is the only vector boundary intertwiner}

families.title: D.4
families.description: Fork-sensitive paired untwisted D family, including the exceptional ell=1 branch.

definitions.label: Paired terms
definitions.latex: M_1=\sum_{1\leq i\leq n}E_{ii},\qquad M_2(u)\text{ is the paired CD.4 matrix-unit sum}

definitions.label: Exceptional paired terms
definitions.latex: M_2^+(u),M_2^-\text{ and }k_2^-(u)\text{ are the explicit terms in }(\mathrm{D4:K:spec})

families.title: B*.1
families.description: Twisted affine A plain family.

definitions.label: Matrix-unit terms
definitions.latex: M_1(u)=\sum_{\bar\ell\leq i\leq n}(\lambda\mu uE_{-i,-i}+E_{ii}),\quad M_2(u)=\sum_{\bar r\leq i<\bar\ell}(\lambda E_{-i,-i}+\lambda^{-1}E_{ii}+E_{-i,i}+E_{i,-i})

families.title: B*.2
families.description: Twisted affine A alternating family.

definitions.label: Matrix-unit terms
definitions.latex: M_1(u)\text{ is diagonal and }M_2(u)\text{ is the alternating matrix-unit sum with the }\delta_{\ell,1}E_{nn}\text{ endpoint term}

families.title: tB*.1
families.description: Transposed presentation of B*.1.

definitions.label: Matrix-unit terms
definitions.latex: M_1(u)\text{ is diagonal and }M_2(u)=\sum_{\bar r\leq i<\bar\ell}(-\lambda E_{-i,-i}+\lambda^{-1}E_{ii}+E_{-i,i}-E_{i,-i})

definitions.label: Parameters
definitions.latex: \lambda=\mathrm{i}q^{n-r},\quad\mu=q^{-\ell-1};\qquad\lambda=\mathrm{i},\ s_n=0\ (r=n)\text{ is the corrected boundary specialization}

families.title: tB*.2
families.description: Transposed presentation of B*.2.

definitions.label: Matrix-unit terms
definitions.latex: M_1(u)\text{ is diagonal and }M_2(u)\text{ is the symmetric alternating sum with }\delta_{r,n-1}(\lambda+\lambda^{-1})E_{11}

families.title: C**.1
families.description: Twisted affine A quadratic plain family.

definitions.label: Matrix-unit terms
definitions.latex: M_1(u)\text{ is diagonal and }M_2(u)=\sum_{\bar r\leq i<\bar\ell}(-\lambda E_{-i,-i}+\lambda^{-1}E_{ii}+E_{-i,i}-E_{i,-i})

families.title: C**.2
families.description: Twisted affine A quadratic alternating family.

definitions.label: Matrix-unit terms
definitions.latex: M_1(u)\text{ is diagonal and }M_2(u)\text{ is the symmetric alternating matrix-unit sum}

families.title: tC**.1
families.description: Transposed presentation of C**.1.

definitions.label: Matrix-unit terms
definitions.latex: M_1(u^2)\text{ and }M_2(u^2)\text{ are the plain paired sums; }E_{0'0'}\text{ is the distinguished quadratic-spectral direction}

families.title: tC**.2
families.description: Transposed presentation of C**.2.

definitions.label: Matrix-unit terms
definitions.latex: M_1(u^2)\text{ and }M_2(u^2)\text{ are the alternating paired sums; }E_{0'0'}\text{ is the distinguished quadratic-spectral direction}

families.title: C*.1
families.description: Twisted affine D plain family.

definitions.label: Matrix-unit terms
definitions.latex: M_1(u^2)\text{ and }M_2(u^2)\text{ are the plain paired sums on }\{-n,\ldots,n,0'\}

families.title: C*.2
families.description: Twisted affine D alternating family.

definitions.label: Matrix-unit terms
definitions.latex: M_1(u^2)\text{ and }M_2(u^2)\text{ are the alternating paired sums on }\{-n,\ldots,n,0'\}

families.title: C*.4
families.description: Twisted affine D involutive family.

definitions.label: Matrix-unit terms
